text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"—Thank you so much for always cheering me on.
I hope I can keep counting on your support!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, my reply to the fan club members...
I feel like it still doesn't express enough gratitude...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I should definitely write more, right?!
Like what made us laugh yesterday! And other stuff too—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: And that's why you didn't get enough sleep...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... but Tsuyoshi says it's OK!
I got to write plenty of good stuff!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though he said that, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi didn't seem to have gotten much rest at all...
